name: What Is My Purpose?

angles.text: As an engineer, you may find the construct's old mechanisms intriguing. Their logic still loops after centuries of wear and no maintenance.
As a shaman, you may take interest in the construct's decline. Local accounts tie its abandonment and failure to the wind elementals' departure.

faq.answer: The Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct is an ancient armored machine that wanders the local fields. The Windshapers once maintained it, but decades without care have left it in disrepair. From beneath its armor, it repeats broken words and errors while asking about its purpose.
faq.q: What is the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct?

faq.answer: Aamelia Windfield lives near the orchard. She says the construct has paced the fields for decades, apparently since the wind elementals departed. The Windshapers once cared for such machines.
The construct's original purpose is unknown. Aamelia Windfield says Alvarion thought it might have hauled harvests to market or tended livestock centuries ago, before the orchard existed.
faq.q: What was the construct's original purpose?

faq.answer: The Windshapers are an ancient group who built and maintained cyclone constructs. Local farmhands have discussed asking them for help, but the construct has caused no urgent concern.

The construct repeats fragmented words because its operation is broken. It has gone without care for decades, since the wind elementals departed. Its speech includes questions about its purpose and reports of errors.
faq.q: Why is the construct repeating fragmented words?

faq.answer: Locals have not repaired or dismantled the construct because it poses no threat as it wanders peacefully among the orchard's trees and crops. Aamelia Windfield and other residents have discussed asking the Windshapers to maintain it, but no urgent need has arisen.
faq.q: Why haven't the locals repaired or dismantled the construct?

faq.answer: Alvarion is a local whom Aamelia Windfield mentions when discussing the construct's past. He thought it might once have hauled harvests to market or tended livestock, before the land became an orchard.

sections.body: A Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct paces through the fields, caught in a broken loop. Muffled fragments come from beneath its armor, repeating errors and questions about its purpose. Decades alone have left its old instructions corrupted or forgotten. It looks imposing, but threatens no one who passes. Its broken voice carries over the soil as it wanders without purpose.
sections.title: The Wandering Construct

sections.body: Aamelia Windfield says the construct has roamed the fields for decades, apparently since the wind elementals departed. Alvarion guessed it once hauled harvests to distant markets or tended livestock, centuries ago, before the land became an orchard. The Windshapers built and maintained cyclone constructs in earlier ages. Orchard workers have talked of asking them to repair the machine, but the matter has never seemed urgent. So it continues to roam, largely ignored.
sections.title: Forgotten Labor and the Windshapers

summary: In the orchard fields, a Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct wanders without purpose. Its broken speech has repeated for decades, since the wind elementals departed. Aamelia Windfield knows what locals remember of its past.
attribution: In-game quest text: What Is My Purpose?
